title: Sr Engineer, Applications Development - SAP Hybris
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Implements tactical and operational goals focused on software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring seamless application delivery. Contributes to the implementation of new automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and deployment standards. Manages software deployment projects and operational processes, coordinating release schedules, dependency tracking, and integration workflows. Works on diverse, multifaceted challenges where analysis requires evaluating software performance, system compatibility, and implementation risks. Derives solutions based on limited precedent, applying best practices in release engineering, infrastructure automation, and software quality assurance to maintain stability and efficiency. Communicates regularly with internal stakeholders, including development, QA, IT operations, and product teams, as well as external vendors and cloud service providers to ensure timely implementation and support.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Senior SAP Hybris Developer:**
 As a Senior member of the e\-commerce technology team, the developer will design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure e\-commerce solutions using SAP Hybris and manage junior members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect \& Lead E\-commerce Platforms: Design and drive scalable, high\-performance, and secure end\-to\-end e\-commerce architectures aligned with enterprise strategy, industry best practices, and long\-term business goals.
* Technical Leadership \& Solution Design: Lead the design and development of complex e\-commerce solutions using SAP Commerce Cloud (SAP CC), Java, Spartacus/Angular, Node.js, Spring Framework, and modern microservices\-based architectures.
* Enterprise Integration Strategy: Architect and oversee seamless integrations with enterprise ecosystems including ERP, CRM, payment gateways, SSO, middleware, and external third\-party services, ensuring reliability and scalability.
* Domain Expertise \& Optimization: Provide deep functional and technical expertise across core e\-commerce domains such as customer profiles, product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flows, payments, pricing, quotes, and order management systems.
* Cross\-functional Leadership: Partner with business stakeholders (marketing, sales, finance, product, and IT leadership) to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and drive digital transformation initiatives.
* Mentorship \& Team Development: Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level developers, enforce coding standards, conduct design reviews, and foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Engineering Excellence \& Governance: Establish best practices for code quality, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, performance tuning, and security compliance. Lead code reviews, architecture reviews, and technical audits.
* Performance, Scalability \& Reliability: Proactively monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and scalability for high\-traffic, business\-critical e\-commerce platforms.
* Innovation \& Modernization: Evaluate and implement modern technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns (e.g., headless commerce, microservices, cloud\-native solutions) to future\-proof the platform.
* Stakeholder Communication \& Delivery Ownership: Take ownership of technical delivery, manage risks, provide estimations, and communicate effectively with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on timelines, scope, and quality expectations.


**Requirements**
 v 8\+ years of E\-Commerce development with at least 6 years in SAP Hybris Commerce / SAP Cloud Commerce.
   

  

 v Hands on Experience on SAP Hybris Core Architecture, Backoffice Cockpits, Impex, SmartEdit and PCM/Backoffice Customization
   

  

 v Knowledge of Zul backend development and Solr search index build / querying
   

  

 v Hybris Item Types and Catalog Management: In\-depth knowledge of product information management and catalog structures.
   

  

 v Understanding of order processes, payment, shipping, and returns. Knowledge of customer profiles, segmentation, and personalization. Understanding of discount mechanisms, pricing rules, and promotions.
   

  

 v Experience integrating Hybris with external systems (ERP, CRM, PIM, etc.).
   

  

 v Java, J2EE (Servlets, JSP, JDBC, JMS, Transactions), Restful API, JSON, XML/XSLT, Java script, Angular / React
   

  

 v Experience on open\-source tools and frameworks: Spring, Hibernate, ANT, MAVEN, JUNIT.
   

  

 v Good knowledge and understanding of DOM, HTML, CSS and JavaScript OOP, MVC, Responsive, Javacript/Jquery and object\-oriented concepts.
   

  

 v Experience on either of Application Servers – JBOSS, Tomcat.
   

  

 v Experience working with Apache/Nginix.
   

  

 v Knowledge and understanding of relational database structure and design using Azure Sql server / Oracle / PostgreSql
   

  

 v Proficiency in Git for code management and collaboration.
   

  

 v Understanding of unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.
   

  

**Disclaimer**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. title: SAP CO-MANAGER
description:

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Consulting \- CO Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Consulting is a fast\-moving, high\-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
   

  

 In this role we are looking for an experienced
 **SAP S4 CO Manager** 
 to join our growing SAP S4 Finance team. As an SAP S/4HANA Controlling Manager you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and optimization of CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis) within the S/4HANA landscape. This role involves acting as a bridge between financial business stakeholders and technical IT teams, ensuring that controlling processes are scalable, accurate, and aligned with company\-wide SAP best practices
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Need to work as a manager in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively.
* Conduct Business Blueprint design workshops to gather requirements and understand the client's business processes
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP CO functionalities need enhancements or customization
* Handle complex enhancements in CO requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client's business requirements
* Provide guidance and support to end\-users during testing, training, and post\-go\-live phases.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the senior manager


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP Controlling Module and CO solution
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills


**What We Look For**
* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / ICMA/ MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience between 7 to 10 years.
* Experience of having worked in an onsite\- offshore delivery model
* Experience with leading business blueprint, gathering and documenting business requirements and designing SAP enabled solutions.
* Experience facilitating cross\-functional team members with complex schedules against a published plan
* Development of project documentation including business process flows, training materials, requirements gathering and project management methodology experience required
* Experience should be in End\-to\-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.
+ Controlling\- CO\-Cost element accounting CO\-Cost Center Accounting and CO\-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge and Hands on experience in CO\-Profitability Analysis \& Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling) and Material Ledger Actual Costing
+ FI integration with MM, SD, HR \& PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills
+ Experience on FIORI APPS, BO\-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools
+ Knowledge in SAP Finance – FI\- New General Ledger \& Profit Center Accounting, FI\-Accounts Payable, FI\-Bank accounting and FI\-Asset Accounting
+ SAP CO – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions \& Reporting.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.
 



**Our Values** 




 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
 


* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** 
 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** 
 We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** 
 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.



 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high\-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company\-level bets on where crypto\-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid\-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.
 



 You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade\-offs, and cross\-functional execution when it matters most.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
* Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
* Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
* Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140\-2\) into a coherent, forward\-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
* Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post\-quantum cryptography (PQC), short\-lived certificates (47\-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
* Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross\-cutting initiatives.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Design on the end\-to\-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
* Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
* Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C\-suite around a shared strategic direction.



 Required Qualifications:
 


* 10\+ years of product management experience, including at least 4\+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
* Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end\-to\-end, from market analysis and vision\-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi\-quarter strategic bets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross\-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
* Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing complex, API\-first products and platform\-level integrations.
* Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.



 Domain Expertise (Preferred):
 



 Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:
 


* Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
* Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST\-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
* Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.



**What’s more in store?** 





 AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health \& wellness policies, saving \& investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L\&D.
 



 What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.
 



**Why AppViewX?** 




 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
 



 AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

description:
Snapsy – Co\-Founder Opportunity
 



  





 Snapsy Technologies is a young startup, right out of Registration and Pilot Run. We’re looking for someone who wants to help build Snapsy from scratch.
 



  





 What’s Snapsy All About?
 



  





 Snapsy is an on\-demand platform for local human tasks — basically, if you need something done near you, Snapsy connects you with someone reliable who can handle it. No endless searching, no guesswork, no weird surprises.
 



  





 The Problem We’re Tackling
 



  





 In Bangalore (and honestly, plenty of Indian cities), people face tiny but annoying tasks every day. Finding someone trustworthy to help, at a fair price, is almost impossible. Helpers have the skills and want regular work, but opportunities are scattered. We want to fix that, make things easier for everyone.
 



  





 Where We Are Right Now
 



  





 \- We’ve talked to real people and the need is clear.
 



 \- Product: There’s a basic version already running.
 



 \- Traction: Early pilots haven’t started yet. We’re at day zero—which is exactly where builders shine.
 



  





 Building Snapsy Side by Side
 



  





 This isn’t just another job. It’s a chance to start shaping Snapsy from the ground up, right alongside the founder.
 



  





 Who We’re Hoping to Find
 



  





 We want someone who loves building things, likes talking to users, and doesn’t mind figuring stuff out without a rulebook. You should be fine with uncertainty, ready to spend time on the ground in Bangalore (especially for the first 90 days), and be in it for the long haul.
 



  





 Must haves:
 



 \- Okay with figuring things out on the fly and with limited resources.
 



 \- Willing to be in Bangalore, boots on the ground, for at least the first 90 days.
 



 \- Comfortable with uncertainty, ready to do whatever needs doing.
 



 \- Fully committed to building this over 5–10\+ years.
 



  





 Nice to haves:
 



 \- Experience taking something from zero to one.
 



 \- Knows how Bangalore actually works at street level.
 



 \- Has worked directly with helpers or customers.
 



  





 Equity\-Only, Full Transparency
 



  





 \- Compensation: Right now, just equity.
 



 \- Runway: We’re keeping it lean on purpose.
 



 \- Risk: No promises about salary, funding, or revenue yet.
 



 \- Reward: Meaningful, founder\-level equity. This is for the long run.
 



  





 What "Success" Means in the First 90 Days
 



  





 Forget scaling for now. If we can get these things repeating smoothly together, we’re winning:
 



  





 Who This Isn’t For
 



  





 Skip this if:
 



 \- You’re after a steady paycheck right now.
 



 \- You treat this as a side hustle—not going to work, full\-time only.
 



 \- You don’t like getting your hands dirty or being on\-ground.
 



 \- You want guarantees about revenue, funding, or when a salary shows up.
 



 \- You care more about a fancy title than actually building.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 If this makes your heart race (in the good way), reach out.
 



  





 Email: \[hello@snapsy.co.in]
 



 Subject: "Co\-founder: \[Your Name] – Snapsy"
 



  





 Include:
 



 1\. A quick note on why you actually want this.
 



 2\. One real example where you got something done with almost nothing (if you’ve got numbers, actions, results, share them).
 



 3\. A task or category in Bangalore we could test, and your plan for getting 5 paid customers and 5 helpers in a week.
 



 4\. Your thoughts on equity\-only right now, and your commitment for the next 5–10\+ years.
 



  





 No generic cover letters. Tell us how you’d jump in, not just what you’ve done.
 



  




* We’re not sugarcoating. We’re just being straight with you. If that’s exciting, let’s build Snapsy together.

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

 As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. * Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life \& Annuity insurance domain.

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.


**Ideally, good to have**
* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps
